[EN] Hi!
Are you done looking around Tower of Shara?
I've got things to do with my friends. I'll play with you later.
See you!
[ES] ¡Hola!
¿Ya terminaste de explorar Tower of Shara?
Tengo cosas que hacer con mis amigos. Jugaré contigo más tarde.
¡Nos vemos!

[EN] Guys, play with me.
[ES] Chicos, jueguen conmigo.
